messages:
Tara (AE): Heads-up — bank wants an isolated POC: USB-only delivery, media <=4GB, absolutely no outbound telemetry, and manual approval for any upgrade. Can we confirm feasibility and a rough POC price? cc @Ravi @Adele

Ravi (SE): Feasible. Two approaches: 1) chunked installer (resumable, small chunks) to meet 4GB cap; 2) stripped full image (simpler but may exceed cap). Chunked needs per-chunk checksums and resume logic.

Adele (Security): Compliance notes: support for HSM signing (PKCS#11) and offline signing OK. We'll provide signing-tool + signing-log artifact. Telemetry disabled by default.

Mark (Customer): What about upgrade approvals? Compliance requires the ops team to sign an approval token before apply. No auto-apply.

Ravi (SE): We support staged-download -> pending state. Approval methods: (a) token file signed by admin key, or (b) short-lived offline CA-signed code. Sample verify command:
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify admin_pub.pem -signature approval.sig approval.json

Liam (Solutions): POC pricing options: basic bundle + 3d support = $9k; hardened delivery (chunking + 5d support) = $18k. Both include SBOM and runbook.

ops-bot: reminder set for 2024-08-01 09:00 to review POC artifacts.

Tara (AE): Action items: Ravi -> short POC runbook (chunk layout + approval flow) by Thu. Adele -> sample signing-log and revocation example by Thu. Liam -> draft quote by Wed. Mark -> confirm procurement cutoff.

Mark (Customer): Procurement window ends 8/10. We'll confirm CA vs HSM by Tue. Thanks.
